    }

    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      touch-action: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    canvas:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    .vignette {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, transparent 48%, rgba(20, 55, 65, 0.16) 100%);
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .title {
      position: fixed;
      top: clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px);
      left: clamp(20px, 4vw, 52px);
      z-index: 3;
      color: #173b43;
      pointer-events: none;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
    }

    .eyebrow {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: 0.22em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      opacity: 0.72;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 0.95;
      letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    }

    .subtitle {
      margin: 12px 0 0;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      opacity: 0.7;
    }

    .controls {
      position: fixed;
      left: clamp(20px, 4vw, 52px);
      bottom: clamp(20px, 4vw, 42px);
      z-index: 3;
      max-width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 40px));
      padding: 13px 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: #173b43;
      background: rgba(244, 250, 247, 0.58);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(24, 61, 68, 0.12);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.025em;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    #reset {
      position: fixed;
      top: clamp(20px, 4vw, 42px);
      right: clamp(20px, 4vw, 42px);
      z-index: 4;
      padding: 10px 15px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: #173b43;
      background: rgba(244, 250, 247, 0.62);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(24, 61, 68, 0.12);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 650;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 160ms ease, background 160ms ease;
    }

    #reset:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .subtitle {
        max-width: 240px;
        line-height: 1.5;
      }

      .controls {
        font-size: 0.66rem;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div id="scene"></div>
  <div class="vignette"></div>

  <header class="title">
    <p class="eyebrow">Traditional craft · modern sky</p>
    <h1>Bamboo Box Kite</h1>
    <p class="subtitle">Hand-framed lattice, woven silk, and a long wind tail.</p>
  </header>

  <button id="reset" type="button">Reset view</button>

  <div class="controls">
    Drag to orbit · Scroll or pinch to zoom · Arrow keys to rotate · Double-click to reset
  </div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const host = document.getElementById("scene");
    const resetButton = document.getElementById("reset");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer, scene, and camera
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;

    renderer.domElement.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "Interactive three-dimensional bamboo-framed box kite"
    );

    host.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xb9dce4);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xb9dce4, 24, 72);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      42,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      120
    );

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Sky dome
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const sky = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(55, 32, 18),
      new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
        side: THREE.BackSide,
        depthWrite: false,
        uniforms: {
          topColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0x78b9d2) },
          horizonColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xe6f0e7) }
        },
        vertexShader: `
          varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

          void main() {
            vec4 worldPosition = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
            vWorldPosition = worldPosition.xyz;
            gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * worldPosition;
          }
        `,
        fragmentShader: `
          uniform vec3 topColor;
          uniform vec3 horizonColor;
          varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

          void main() {
            float height = normalize(vWorldPosition).y;
            float blend = smoothstep(-0.18, 0.78, height);
            vec3 color = mix(horizonColor, topColor, blend);
            gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
          }
        `
      })
    );

    sky.renderOrder = -10;
    scene.add(sky);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xe2f5ff, 0x52603d, 1.75);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const sunlight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1cf, 3.2);
    sunlight.position.set(9, 14, 10);
    sunlight.castShadow = true;
    sunlight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    sunlight.shadow.camera.left = -16;
    sunlight.shadow.camera.right = 16;
    sunlight.shadow.camera.top = 16;
    sunlight.shadow.camera.bottom = -16;
    sunlight.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    sunlight.shadow.camera.far = 45;
    sunlight.shadow.bias = -0.00035;
    scene.add(sunlight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x9ed8e8, 0.8);
    fillLight.position.set(-10, 5, -8);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const bambooMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xd5a64d,
      roughness: 0.7,
      metalness: 0.015
    });

    const bambooNodeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x9b6825,
      roughness: 0.8
    });

    const bambooBraceMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xe0b661,
      roughness: 0.64,
      metalness: 0.01
    });

    const redSilkMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      roughness: 0.84,
      metalness: 0,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    const goldMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xd6a84b,
      roughness: 0.55,
      metalness: 0.18
    });

    const stringMaterial = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x595349,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.82
    });

    // Procedural woven-silk texture; no external image assets.
    function createSilkTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 512;
      canvas.height = 512;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      context.fillStyle = "#b63027";
      context.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

      for (let i = 0; i < 2200; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 512;
        const y = Math.random() * 512;
        const light = Math.random() > 0.5;

        context.strokeStyle = light
          ? `rgba(255,220,170,${0.015 + Math.random() * 0.035})`
          : `rgba(68,10,12,${0.015 + Math.random() * 0.035})`;

        context.lineWidth = Math.random() * 1.2 + 0.2;
        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(x, y);
        context.lineTo(x + Math.random() * 3, y + 20 + Math.random() * 60);
        context.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(2, 2);
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

      return texture;
    }

    redSilkMaterial.map = createSilkTexture();

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Geometry helpers
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const unitCylinder = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 12, 1, false);
    const upAxis = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

    function cylinderBetween(start, end, radius, material, radialSegments = 12) {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
      const length = direction.length();

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(unitCylinder, material);
      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(upAxis, direction.normalize());
      mesh.scale.set(radius, length, radius);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;

      return mesh;
    }

    function addLine(points) {
      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points);
      const line = new THREE.Line(geometry, stringMaterial);
      scene.add(line);
      return line;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Bamboo-framed box kite
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const kite = new THREE.Group();
    kite.position.y = 0.6;
    scene.add(kite);

    const frameZFront = 0.82;
    const frameZBack = -0.82;

    const corners = {
      frontLeft: new THREE.Vector3(-4, -3, frameZFront),
      frontRight: new THREE.Vector3(4, -3, frameZFront),
      backLeft: new THREE.Vector3(-4, 3, frameZFront),
      backRight: new THREE.Vector3(4, 3, frameZFront),
      frontBottomLeft: new THREE.Vector3(-4, -3, frameZFront),
      frontBottomRight: new THREE.Vector3(4, -3, frameZFront),
      backBottomLeft: new THREE.Vector3(-4, -3, frameZBack),
      backBottomRight: new THREE.Vector3(4, -3, frameZBack),
      backTopLeft: new THREE.Vector3(-4, 3, frameZBack),
      backTopRight: new THREE.Vector3(4, 3, frameZBack)
    };

    // Front and back rectangular frames.
    for (const z of [frameZFront, frameZBack]) {
      kite.add(
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(-4, -3, z),
          new THREE.Vector3(4, -3, z),
          0.16
        ),
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(-4, 3, z),
          new THREE.Vector3(4, 3, z),
          0.16
        ),
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(-4, -3, z),
          new THREE.Vector3(-4, 3, z),
          0.16
        ),
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(4, -3, z),
          new THREE.Vector3(4, 3, z),
          0.16
        )
      );
    }

    // Depth rails form the box structure.
    for (const x of [-4, 4]) {
      for (const y of [-3, 0, 3]) {
        kite.add(
          cylinderBetween(
            new THREE.Vector3(x, y, frameZFront),
            new THREE.Vector3(x, y, frameZBack),
            y === 0 ? 0.115 : 0.13
          )
        );
      }
    }

    // Corner braces.
    for (const x of [-4, 4]) {
      kite.add(
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(x, -3, frameZFront),
          new THREE.Vector3(x, 3, frameZFront),
          0.12
        ),
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(x, -3, frameZBack),
          new THREE.Vector3(x, 3, frameZBack),
          0.12
        )
      );
    }

    // Front and back diagonal lattice.
    const frontDiagonals = [
      [corners.frontBottomLeft, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1.0)],
      [corners.frontBottomRight, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1.0)],
      [corners.backBottomLeft, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1.0)],
      [corners.backBottomRight, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1.0)],
      [corners.frontTopLeft, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1.0)],
      [corners.frontTopRight, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1.0)],
      [corners.backTopLeft, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1.0)],
      [corners.backTopRight, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1.0)]
    ];

    for (const [a, b] of frontDiagonals) {
      kite.add(
        cylinderBetween(a, b, 0.052, bambooBraceMaterial, 10)
      );
    }

    // Central front cross, dividing the silk into four panels.
    kite.add(
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, -3, 0.9),
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 3, 0.9),
        0.075,
        bambooBraceMaterial
      ),
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(-4, 0, 0.9),
        new THREE.Vector3(4, 0, 0.9),
        0.075,
        bambooBraceMaterial
      )
    );

    // Silk panels for the front, back, and side walls.
    const frontPanel = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(7.85, 5.85),
      redSilkMaterial
    );
    frontPanel.position.z = frameZFront - 0.035;
    frontPanel.receiveShadow = true;
    kite.add(frontPanel);

    const backPanel = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(7.85, 5.85),
      redSilkMaterial
    );
    backPanel.position.z = frameZBack + 0.035;
    backPanel.rotation.y = Math.PI;
    backPanel.receiveShadow = true;
    kite.add(backPanel);

    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const sidePanel = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.PlaneGeometry(5.85, 1.6),
        redSilkMaterial
      );
      sidePanel.position.set(side * 4, 0, 0);
      sidePanel.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
      sidePanel.receiveShadow = true;
      kite.add(sidePanel);
    }

    // Decorative golden medallions on all four front panels.
    const panelCenters = [
      new THREE.Vector3(-2, -1.5, 1.07),
      new THREE.Vector3(2, -1.5, 1.07),
      new THREE.Vector3(-2, 1.5, 1.07),
      new THREE.Vector3(2, 1.5, 1.07)
    ];

    for (const center of panelCenters) {
      const medallion = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.24, 28),
        goldMaterial
      );
      medallion.position.copy(center);
      kite.add(medallion);

      const centerDot = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.055, 18),
        bambooNodeMaterial
      );
      centerDot.position.set(center.x, center.y, center.z + 0.012);
      kite.add(centerDot);
    }

    // Repeated bamboo nodes on the main vertical frame.
    for (const x of [-4, 4]) {
      for (const y of [-2.4, 0, 2.4]) {
        const node = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.145, 0.026, 7, 20),
          bambooNodeMaterial
        );
        node.position.set(x, y, frameZFront);
        node.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        node.castShadow = true;
        kite.add(node);
      }
    }

    // Nodes on the top and bottom frame.
    for (const y of [-3, 3]) {
      for (const x of [-2.4, 0, 2.4]) {
        const node = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.145, 0.026, 7, 20),
          bambooNodeMaterial
        );
        node.position.set(x, y, frameZFront);
        node.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
        node.castShadow = true;
        kite.add(node);
      }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Tail and tassels
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const tailGroup = new THREE.Group();
    kite.add(tailGroup);

    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const stripe = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.43, 0.78),
        i % 2 === 0 ? redSilkMaterial : goldMaterial
      );
      stripe.position.set(0, -3.45 - i * 0.78, 0);
      stripe.castShadow = true;
      tailGroup.add(stripe);
    }

    // Tassel threads.
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const x = (i - 3) * 0.055;
      const thread = cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(x, -7.78, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(x * 1.25, -8.22, 0),
        0.012,
        stringMaterial,
        6
      );
      tailGroup.add(thread);
    }

    // Three hanging tassels.
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const tassel = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.12, 0.38, 7),
        i % 2 === 0 ? redSilkMaterial : goldMaterial
      );
      tassel.position.set((i - 1) * 0.13, -8.27, 0);
      tassel.rotation.z = Math.PI;
      tassel.castShadow = true;
      tailGroup.add(tassel);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Control lines and spool
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const spool = new THREE.Vector3(0, 4.35, 0);

    kite.add(
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(spool.x, spool.y, -0.25),
        new THREE.Vector3(spool.x, spool.y, 0.25),
        0.17,
        bambooMaterial
      )
    );

    const controlLines = [
      [new THREE.Vector3(spool.x, spool.y, 0), corners.frontLeft],
      [new THREE.Vector3(spool.x, spool.y, 0), corners.frontRight],
      [new THREE.Vector3(spool.x, spool.y, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 3, frameZFront)],
      [new THREE.Vector3(-4, 3, frameZFront), new THREE.Vector3(-1.25, -2.7, 0)],
      [new THREE.Vector3(4, 3, frameZFront), new THREE.Vector3(1.25, -2.7, 0)],
      [new THREE.Vector3(-4, -3, frameZFront), new THREE.Vector3(-1.25, -2.7, 0)],
      [new THREE.Vector3(4, -3, frameZFront), new THREE.Vector3(1.25, -2.7, 0)],
      [new THREE.Vector3(0, 3, frameZFront), new THREE.Vector3(0, -2.7, 0)]
    ];

    for (const [a, b] of controlLines) {
      addLine([a, b]);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Landscape
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x718c61,
        roughness: 1
      })
    );
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = -9.15;
    ground.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(ground);

    const hillMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x6f8c69,
      roughness: 1
    });

    const hillData = [
      [-16, -8.45, -20, 12, 2.4, 6],
      [0, -8.7, -24, 15, 2.8, 7],
      [18, -8.5, -21, 13, 2.3, 6],
      [-25, -8.25, -16, 10, 2.0, 5]
    ];

    for (const [x, y, z, sx, sy, sz] of hillData) {
      const hill = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 18, 10),
        hillMaterial
      );
      hill.position.set(x, y, z);
      hill.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
      hill.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(hill);
    }

    const trunkMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x695039,
      roughness: 1
    });

    const leafMaterials = [
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3f7048, roughness: 1 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x58824e, roughness: 1 })
    ];

    function createTree(x, z, scale) {
      const tree = new THREE.Group();
      tree.position.set(x, -9.05, z);
      tree.scale.setScalar(scale);

      const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.14, 0.22, 2.4, 8),
        trunkMaterial
      );
      trunk.position.y = 1.2;
      trunk.castShadow = true;
      tree.add(trunk);

      const lower = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.05, 2.4, 9),
        leafMaterials[0]
      );
      lower.position.y = 2.65;
      lower.castShadow = true;
      tree.add(lower);

      const upper = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.78, 2.0, 9),
        leafMaterials[1]
      );
      upper.position.y = 3.85;
      upper.castShadow = true;
      tree.add(upper);

      scene.add(tree);
    }

    createTree(-9, -5, 1.15);
    createTree(-12, -1, 0.85);
    createTree(9, -7, 1.2);
    createTree(13, -3, 0.9);
    createTree(-15, 8, 1.0);
    createTree(15, 9, 1.25);
    createTree(4, 13, 0.8);
    createTree(-4, 15, 0.95);

    // Soft low-poly clouds.
    const cloudMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xf5f7ef,
      roughness: 1,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.86,
      depthWrite: false
    });

    const clouds = [];

    function createCloud(x, y, z, scale) {
      const cloud = new THREE.Group();
      cloud.position.set(x, y, z);
      cloud.scale.setScalar(scale);

      const puffs = [
        [-1.25, 0, 0, 1.05, 0.55, 0.65],
        [-0.35, 0.25, 0, 1.25, 0.7, 0.7],
        [0.65, 0.05, 0, 1.15, 0.62, 0.68],
        [1.45, -0.05, 0, 0.85, 0.48, 0.55],
        [0.1, -0.2, 0.2, 1.35, 0.62, 0.72]
      ];

      for (const [px, py, pz, sx, sy, sz] of puffs) {
        const puff = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 14, 10),
          cloudMaterial
        );
        puff.position.set(px, py, pz);
        puff.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
        cloud.add(puff);
      }

      cloud.userData.speed = 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.12;
      clouds.push(cloud);
      scene.add(cloud);
    }

    createCloud(-9, 4.5, -14, 1.6);
    createCloud(8, 6.5, -19, 2.1);
    createCloud(15, 2.5, -12, 1.25);
    createCloud(-18, 1.5, -22, 1.4);

    // Warm sun disc.
    const sun = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.8, 20, 12),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffe4a3 })
    );
    sun.position.set(-13, 10, -25);
    scene.add(sun);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom camera controls
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const cameraState = {
      yaw: 0.22,
      pitch: 0.08,
      distance: 19.5,
      target: new THREE.Vector3(0, -1.45, 0)
    };

    const defaultCamera = {
      yaw: 0.22,
      pitch: 0.08,
      distance: 19.5
    };

    function updateCamera() {
      const { yaw, pitch, distance, target } = cameraState;
      const horizontal = Math.cos(pitch) * distance;

      camera.position.set(
        target.x + Math.sin(yaw) * horizontal,
        target.y + Math.sin(pitch) * distance,
        target.z + Math.cos(yaw) * horizontal
      );

      camera.lookAt(target);
    }

    function resetCamera() {
      cameraState.yaw = defaultCamera.yaw;
      cameraState.pitch = defaultCamera.pitch;
      cameraState.distance = defaultCamera.distance;
      updateCamera();
    }

    const pointers = new Map();
    let lastX = 0;
    let lastY = 0;
    let previousPinchDistance = 0;

    function pointerDistance() {
      const values = [...pointers.values()];
      if (values.length < 2) return 0;

      return Math.hypot(
        values[0].x - values[1].x,
